Raketle topu sektir, tuğlaları kır! Ücre: Bounce the ball and smash the bricks! Free brick breaker game: 30 levels, stars, power-ups, upgrades and endless mode. Works on phones too
Tuğla kırma oyun alanı. Ok tuşlarıyla ra: Brick breaker game area. Move the paddle with the arrow keys, launch the ball with Space
Raket dokunmadan 5 tuğla kır (5x kombo): Break 5 bricks without touching the paddle (5x combo)
Bir bölümü can kaybetmeden bitir: Finish a level without losing a life
Herkese aynı 3 bölüm. Yükseltmeler kapal: The same 3 levels for everyone. No upgrades, 3 lives, get the highest score.
You need 15 stars in Forest to unlock Desert.
Fırlatmak için dokun veya Boşluk: Tap or press Space to launch
Tuğla Kırma'da ekranın altındaki raketi: In Brick Breaker you move the paddle at the bottom of the screen left and right to keep the ball in the air and smash the bricks above. On a computer use the arrow keys or A/D; on a phone, slide your finger across the game area. Your finger can stay below the paddle so it doesn't cover it. Press Space or tap the screen to launch the ball. A ball that hits the middle of the paddle bounces straight up, one that hits the edges comes back at a flatter angle. Break every brick except the metal ones to clear the level. Miss the ball and you lose a life; lose them all and you retry the level. Press P or Esc to pause
Normal tuğla tek vuruşta kırılır. Sağlam: A normal brick breaks in one hit. Tough bricks take two or three hits and crack and fade with each one. Grey metal bricks can't be broken and don't need to be to clear the level. A 💥 exploding brick destroys the bricks around it, and a ❓ surprise brick drops a capsule. Catch capsules with your paddle: ↔️ Wide Paddle, ⚪ Multi Ball (two extra balls), 🐢 Slow Ball, 🔫 Laser (fire with Space, automatic on touch screens) and 🍯 Sticky Paddle (the ball sticks to the paddle and you launch it when you like). Dodge the grey 🤏 Narrow Paddle capsule in later levels. With Multi Ball active you only lose a life when the last ball falls
Orman, Çöl ve Uzay dünyalarında toplam 3: There are 30 levels across the Forest, Desert and Space worlds, and the last level of each world has a boss castle with a health bar. Clearing a level gives 1 star, losing at most one life gives 2, and clearing it within the target time without losing a life gives 3. You need 15 stars in a world to move on to the next. Each new star earns 1 diamond, the first win against a boss earns 5, and daily tasks give diamonds too. Spend diamonds to permanently boost paddle width, starting lives, capsule duration, capsule chance and laser power. Beating bosses unlocks new paddle skins and ball trails, and after level 30 comes Endless Mode for chasing high scores
Topu raketin kenarıyla karşılamak sert a: Hitting the ball with the edge of the paddle gives sharp angles. Use them to get the ball behind the rows of bricks, where it bounces between the top wall and the bricks and breaks lots of them on its own for a combo. Every brick broken before the paddle touches the ball raises the combo multiplier. After catching Multi Ball, position the paddle under the lowest ball. Putting your first diamonds into Paddle Width makes early levels easier, and Starting Lives helps a lot for three stars
<strong>İlerlemem kaydediliyor mu?</stro: Is my progress saved? Yes, your stars, diamonds and upgrades are saved automatically in this browser. What is the daily challenge? In daily mode everyone plays the same three levels without upgrades and scores are compared. Does it cost anything? No, the game is completely free and needs no download.
